name: Martin Marietta Materials
outlook:
What Martin Marietta Materials says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue and adjusted EBITDA midpointsWith the closing of LNA, we have updated the midpoints of our full-year 2026 Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $7.80 billion and $2.48 billion, respectively, as acquisition contributions are anticipated to more than offset lower near-term expectations for our heritage operations.
  • 2027: aggregates pricingIn 2027, we expect mid- to high-single digit aggregates pricing on a mix-adjusted basis, supported by January 1 pricing actions designed to address inflationary cost pressures.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
